title: Honey-Soy Glazed Pork Chops
description: Thick-cut pork chops seared hard in a hot skillet, then finished with a sticky honey-soy glaze that caramelizes into something addictive. Five minutes of prep, fifteen minutes of cooking.

steps.text: Whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl. Set aside.
Pat pork chops dry. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Heat vegetable oil in a large cast-iron or heavy skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking. Lay in the pork chops and sear without moving until a dark golden crust forms, about 4 minutes. Flip and sear the other side, another 4 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium. Pour the honey-soy glaze into the skillet around the chops. Let it bubble and thicken, spooning the glaze over the chops repeatedly as it reduces, 2 to 3 minutes. The glaze should turn syrupy and coat the back of the spoon.
Check the chops — they should register 145°F at the thickest point. If not, cover the pan and cook another minute or two.
Transfer chops to plates, spoon remaining glaze from the pan over top. Finish with sesame seeds and scallions. Serve with steamed rice.
